scope: Default-disabled requester intake/status/cancellation/exact recovery with PostgreSQL repository and additive schema; pure request and retention proposals; lifecycle operator assurance policy.

GDN-032-AC01.requirement: Deletion stops new delivery and queues derivative removal
GDN-032-AC01.implemented_contribution: Authenticated own-request intake, status, cancellation and exact recovery are implemented locally. Pending/cancelled receipts do not establish target ownership, approve deletion, stop delivery or enqueue removal.
GDN-032-AC01.remaining: Authoritative operator decisions, record-wide delivery tombstones, current access enforcement, complete derivative/material inventory and removal queue.

GDN-032-AC02.requirement: Holds have authority, scope and review date
GDN-032-AC02.implemented_contribution: Strict immutable rules and holds require exact scope, explicit finite dates, evidence and versioned authority. Operator-bound complete command fingerprints and full-proof operation fingerprints protect proposals and explicit release/replay. Expired, overdue, missing, stale, unresolved or conflicting facts require review.
GDN-032-AC02.remaining: Current operator grants and verified authority/evidence resolution, persisted retention rules and hold records, atomic control revisions, complete material inventory and enforced disposal constraints.

GDN-032-AC03.requirement: Restores reapply current deletions and consent
GDN-032-AC03.implemented_contribution: Requester history rejects a rewound head when a newer immutable event remains. This is request metadata integrity, not restore-after-withdrawal acceptance.
GDN-032-AC03.remaining: Restore quarantine/current tombstone and consent reapplication, protected-delivery verification and a real bounded recovery drill.

test_scenarios.GDN-032-T01: Tombstone/reindex workflow not implemented or exercised. Request history and receipt tests are preparatory only.
test_scenarios.GDN-032-T02: Restore-after-withdrawal not implemented or exercised. Requester head/payload restoration probes are not this scenario.
test_scenarios.GDN-032-T03: Pure hold expiry, exact release, stale authority and conflicting-period fixtures pass; persisted hold enforcement and real current-facts integration remain pending.

implementation_boundaries.operator_review: Pure reviewed intent only; no persisted accept/decline or scoped lifecycle.administer grant model.
implementation_boundaries.operator_assurance: lifecycle.administer requires the existing privileged session assurance policy; requester own-request operations do not require an operator passkey.
implementation_boundaries.retention_effects: Pure dry-run review; no legal timeline inferred, no purge capability issued.
implementation_boundaries.sql_schema: 0014_lifecycle_requests.sql defines requester cases, payloads, events, heads, tickets and contexts; it adds no retention_rules, deletion_tombstones or hold_records.

unit_count_snapshot.basis: Existing plan/progress.json; this partial contribution changes no mapped completion or production count.

ai_source_review: Bounded implementing/coordinating/separate AI peer review; concrete findings corrected. See review.md.
evidence_scope: These observations bind the source commit above. This later evidence-only commit does not claim a new full-check execution or future GitHub results.
